title: F13. Flexibility Assessment Methods
content:
### F13. Flexibility Assessment Methods
**ID:** F13 **Created:** 2025-06-05

Flexibility assessment methods encompass standardized protocols for measuring range of motion (ROM) across various joints and movement planes to evaluate mobility limitations and guide corrective exercise prescription. These assessments provide crucial baseline data for injury prevention, movement quality enhancement, and monitoring improvements in tissue extensibility and joint mobility.

**Core Components:**
- **Goniometric Measurement:** Precise joint angle assessment using standard and digital goniometers to quantify active and passive range of motion across major joints [[../foundation/A17. Movement Screening]]
- **Functional Movement Screens:** Integrated movement assessments that evaluate flexibility within the context of fundamental movement patterns and identify mobility restrictions [[../cross_training/L2. Mobility and Flexibility Development]]
- **Muscle Length Testing:** Specific tests for individual muscle groups including hip flexors, hamstrings, gastrocnemius, and shoulder complex to identify tissue-specific limitations [[../foundation/A15. Biomechanics Posture Analysis]]
- **Dynamic Assessment Protocols:** Movement-based evaluations including leg swings, arm circles, and multi-planar reaches to assess functional mobility during active motion [[../cross_training/L1. Movement Patterns and Functional Training]]
- **Normative Comparisons:** Interpretation of results using age, gender, and sport-specific norms to determine clinical significance and training priorities [[../integrated_approaches/O2. Measuring Fitness Progress]]
